title: Gate command binding (F153-FR-010 to -012; data-model.md D1)
description: The declared command set the verification gate ran, its runner binding and the tree fingerprint taken at gate run. Written once per gate run beside the phase attempt's verification record; read by the closing-check equality test (F153-FR-012) and, only if the owner adopts amendment CQ-153-02 A, by the reuse table (F153-FR-013). PROPOSAL of spec 153 — not normative until its tasks land.

id.$comment: the plan's own command id inside GATE-phase-<N>

treeFingerprint.$comment: the F116 working-tree fingerprint as produced by workingTreeFingerprint; the digest width follows F116, not this schema

resolvedByRule.$comment: the rule id of core/src/gate/command-resolution.ts that resolved this set (F153-FR-008, XIII)

exitCode.$comment: null when the command was killed at its time limit (F148-FR-004)
